subject: Re: MultimodalChat kickoff — staffing plan
body:
Priya,

Staffing plan for the half:

- Yara: share-intent model (lead)
- Hyun + Carmen: retrieval model and dialogue-context encoder
- Efe: eval design, including the human-judged relevance pass
- Amara Okafor: image retrieval index and serving path — I have her committed at 60% to MultimodalChat for June 2026, which is what the index build plus the Shipyard integration needs. She drops to 30% in July once the index is in maintenance mode.

Compute is modest; titan-a100 best-effort covers both model families. The Shipyard demo slot for late July is requested with Zeke's team — they want the serving config three weeks ahead, so Amara's June allocation is genuinely the critical path here.

One flag: Open Image download via the external mirror is slower than expected; Amara is parallelizing the pull.

Alina
